name: eggshell
description: Reduce repeated Codex work with a persistent, user-controlled work graph

interface.shortDescription: Continue related work without rediscovering it.
interface.longDescription: Eggshell records native Codex work in user-controlled .egg files, then uses Union and saturation to hand later sessions reusable outcomes and an open frontier.
defaultPrompt: Continue this task from relevant prior work without repeating completed investigation.
